data.value: Shows a real control with the style or ControlTemplate applied. A second, disabled sample appears when the style reacts to IsEnabled.

data.name: OverriddenKeyWarningFormat
data.value: Resource '{0}' is overridden by the definition in {1} (line {2}) when loaded through {3}. WPF does not use this definition.
data.comment: {0} = key, {1} = file that wins, {2} = line, {3} = App.xaml or window file

data.name: OptionsWarnOverriddenDescription
data.value: Shows a warning in the Error List for each resource that WPF never uses, because a dictionary that is merged later defines the same key.

data.name: OptionsShowInCompletionDescription
data.value: Shows an icon for images, geometries and brushes in the IntelliSense list after {StaticResource or {DynamicResource, and the preview in the tooltip of the selected item.

data.name: MissingStaticKeyFormat
data.value: '{0}' is not defined anywhere in this solution. WPF throws an exception when it loads this StaticResource.

data.name: MissingDynamicKeyFormat
data.value: '{0}' is not defined anywhere in this solution. This DynamicResource stays empty unless code adds the key.

data.name: DidYouMeanFormat
data.value: Keys are case-sensitive. Did you mean '{0}'?

data.name: DefinedLaterFormat
data.value: '{0}' is only defined further down in this file (line {1}). A StaticResource must be defined above the place where it is used, otherwise WPF throws an exception when loading.

data.name: NotLoadedFormat
data.value: '{0}' is defined in {1}, but WPF does not search that file from here. It throws an exception when it loads this StaticResource.

data.name: OptionsCheckReferencesDescription
data.value: Shows a warning in the Error List for references to keys that do not exist, are only defined further down in the same file, or are in a file that is not loaded there.

data.name: ReferencesNotFoundHere
data.value: WPF does not find the key here

data.name: UnusedResourceFormat
data.value: Resource '{0}' is not used anywhere in this solution, not in XAML and not in code.

data.name: OptionsReportUnusedDescription
data.value: Shows a message in the Error List for each resource that no XAML file and no code file in the solution uses. Only for files the app loads.

data.name: RenameSummaryFormat
